headlines.title: What Does Netflix (NFLX) Leadership Shakeup Mean For Its Streaming Future?
headlines.summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX) has launched a major restructuring that includes about 1,000 employee layoffs across creative and corporate teams. Longtime content leaders Dan Lin and Bela Bajaria are exiting, removing two key figures from Netflix's film and series operations. Veteran Hollywood executive Peter Rice is joining as chief content officer, taking control of Netflix's global programming strategy.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
